levels.$note: Below elevated is low; from elevated, elevated; from high, high.

scales.$note: How a raw figure becomes a risk from 0 to 100. Each is a straight line between the two ends, clamped.

unrest.$note: After an election: incidents in the first days after it against the same number of days before, from the GDELT counts. 'Unrest' when the count after is at least ratio times the count before, and at least minEvents.
